blocks.text: Bea Millan-Windorski carried the colors of the Philippine flag when she kicked off her journey to the 2026 Miss Univers pageant, where she is on a mission to post the country’s fifth victory. At her departure in Manila, she opted for a bright yellow ensemble reflecting the colors of the three stars and the sun on the Philippine flag. The bright hue lit up the festive atmosphere as throngs of supporters sent her off at Terminal 1 of the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) in Pasay City on Nov. 5.
